outcome: Every active task has a durable HTML review page spanning unknowns, implementation notes, buy-in and an interactive quiz.
unknowns: Can strict lifecycle admission preserve honest partial handoffs and legacy history? Will a deterministic renderer be sufficient for readable offline review?
assumptions: Structural checks cannot prove comprehension or that preflight preceded all code edits. Git history and command snapshots provide bounded provenance.
alternatives: A generated optional report was rejected by the user. Adopt mandatory checked-in HTML with structured source and append-only lifecycle content.
verification: Exercise real xtask commands for lifecycle, invalid inputs, missing/stale HTML, preserved history, legacy migration and quiz feedback; run full CI.
